---
title: smalldocs 0.1.3
subtitle: A config file of its own, and a better API reference
date: 2026-10-10
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

smalldocs now has a config file of its own, `_smalldocs.yml`. In it, the options of a page, such as
`theme` and `toc`, are at the top level. The options of smalldocs, such as `linkify` and `api`, are at
the top level too. smalldocs still builds a Quarto project from its `_quarto.yml`, with no change. See
[The configuration](../guide/config.qmd).

The API reference has these changes:

- A field of a pydantic model takes its description from `Field(description=...)`. If the field has no
  description, it takes the comment beside the field.
- A click command shows its function, with the comment beside each parameter, and a table of its
  options.
- A package whose `__init__.py` defines code has a page of its own.
- In `api.check`, the glob `tests/**/*.py` finds `tests/conftest.py` too.
- `smalldocs api check` names each file by its path from the root, such as `tests/test_x.py`. So the
  output is the same on every computer.

See [The API reference](../guide/api.qmd).
